_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live cluster inside Complacency band with 7% ±2 coil base rate; post-FOMC window is live but no breaker yet, so HOLD the rung and treat supply as tactical only.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward HOLD/Complacency with tactical SHORT; narrative is cross-asset pipe divergence without a phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55 and 30d momentum stays near flat through opex/post-FOMC
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 40 with ETF flows and CVD still deteriorating, or daily close back above 82000 with F&G above 62
